en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a European city square with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings, shops with striped awnings at street level, and people in Edwardian‑era clothing walking across a broad plaza. A decorative cast‑iron streetlamp stands prominently in the foreground. Large painted wall advertisements in German are visible on the side of a building, and a monument or fountain is faintly visible deeper in the square.
